meaning: Research questions and evidence state. Presence here does not mean a valid result.

experiments.title: Exact-oracle consequence score
experiments.question: Does CCE rank states like the exact action-gap oracle?
experiments.conclusion: The saved slippery-policy checkpoints show useful oracle alignment.

experiments.title: Deterministic five-arm learning study
experiments.question: Does CCE improve sparse deterministic learning over Uniform and PER?
experiments.conclusion: CCE multiplicative solved 20 of 25 seeds; PER solved 12 and Uniform solved 10.

experiments.title: Slippery five-arm learning study
experiments.question: Does CCE improve learning under FrozenLake transition noise?
experiments.conclusion: The five arms clustered; no clean CCE gain was found.

experiments.title: Coarse slip sweep
experiments.question: Does CCE benefit decay smoothly as transition noise rises?
experiments.conclusion: Only slip zero cleared the comparison; killed runs required later cleanup.

experiments.title: Dense low-slip sweep
experiments.question: Is there a low-noise window where CCE still beats PER?
experiments.conclusion: CCE multiplicative beat PER at slip zero and not at slip 0.02 through 0.133.

experiments.title: CCE suitability rollouts
experiments.question: Can cheap rollout signals predict when CCE will help?

experiments.title: CCE, TD, and update covariance
experiments.question: How do CCE score, TD error, and update value move together?

experiments.title: Fixed stochastic transfer
experiments.question: Can the latest matched CCE protocol transfer to slippery FrozenLake?

experiments.title: SMAX 3m five-arm study
experiments.question: Does CCE improve multi-agent learning?
experiments.conclusion: CCE multiplicative was 0.722 versus PER 0.710; this is not a strong win.

experiments.title: SMAX 8m study
experiments.question: Does the 3m result hold in the larger scenario?

experiments.title: SMAX and SMAC historical sweeps
experiments.question: Which metrics, mixing rules, and replay arms were tried before the paper cohort?

experiments.title: Routing exact-oracle study
experiments.question: Does CCE identify high-impact routing decisions?
experiments.conclusion: Oracle correlation rose from untrained to mid-training and remained high when trained.

experiments.title: Routing learning runs
experiments.question: Does CCE improve routing policy learning?
experiments.conclusion: No clean learning gain was accepted.

experiments.title: Budget and orienteering sweeps
experiments.question: Does CCE help when route choice is constrained by a budget?
experiments.conclusion: The recovered sweep was treated as a null study.

experiments.title: Neural routing DQN study
experiments.question: Can CCE help the neural routing learner?

experiments.title: Gardner chess transfer
experiments.question: Does CCE help chess learning and identify strong oracle moves?
experiments.conclusion: No learning gain was found; the oracle opponent was too weak.

experiments.title: Sampled-score buffer coverage
experiments.question: How much of replay memory receives a CCE score?

experiments.title: Early easy-map pilot
experiments.question: Can the first JaxNav learner solve the easier map cell?

experiments.title: Early holes-map pilot
experiments.question: Can CCE improve the early holes-map setup?

experiments.title: CCE aggregation pilot
experiments.question: How do max and weighted-mean aggregation differ?

experiments.title: Long-budget and power studies
experiments.question: Does more training or more seeds reveal a stable CCE gain?

experiments.title: Priority balance and ESS
experiments.question: How concentrated is replay after CCE and TD mixing?

experiments.title: Counterfactual bootstrap sweep
experiments.question: Does value bootstrap change CCE learning?

experiments.title: Replay capacity sweeps
experiments.question: Does replay capacity explain the learning outcome?

experiments.title: Map and CCE factorial sweep
experiments.question: Which map and CCE settings create useful headroom?

experiments.title: Priority normalization, drift, and frequency
experiments.question: Do normalization, stale scores, or scoring cadence explain CCE behavior?

experiments.title: Replay instrumentation study
experiments.question: What does CCE actually score and replay?

experiments.title: Greedy-policy coverage
experiments.question: Does policy choice explain low CCE score coverage?

experiments.title: Score every new transition
experiments.question: Does score-on-insert reach full replay coverage?
experiments.conclusion: Measured coverage reached 100 percent in the retained runs.

experiments.title: Paper reward comparison
experiments.question: Does the sparse paper reward change CCE behavior?

experiments.title: Dense reward fixed evaluation
experiments.question: How do replay arms compare on one fixed map bank under dense reward?

experiments.title: Additive and CCE-only fixed evaluation
experiments.question: Do additive or CCE-only replay beat multiplicative replay?

experiments.title: Radius and map-size baseline sweep
experiments.question: How do Uniform and PER change as goals become rarer?

experiments.title: Radius and map-size CCE sweep
experiments.question: Does CCE gain appear when goal discovery becomes rarer?

experiments.title: Eight-by-eight additive rarity sweep
experiments.question: Does additive CCE change the rarity result?

experiments.title: Fixed 1,000-map evaluation
experiments.question: How do Uniform, PER, and CCE compare on the same evaluation maps?
experiments.conclusion: CCE learned early in some seeds but later collapsed; the result was mixed.

experiments.title: Q-value and loss controls
experiments.question: Do Q-values or loss explain JaxNav collapse?

experiments.title: Q-diagnostic smoke
experiments.question: Does diagnostic logging work without changing training?

experiments.title: Action-hold temporal study
experiments.question: Does repeating a selected action for 20 steps change learning?

experiments.title: Chunk carry pilot
experiments.question: Does carrying terminal and reset state across chunks fix episode accounting?
experiments.conclusion: The old collector dropped carry state at chunk boundaries.

experiments.title: Ranked-TD decay study
experiments.question: Does fading CCE into ranked TD from 100k to 150k prevent late collapse?

experiments.title: Ranked-TD decay migrated recipe
experiments.question: Can the decay study run through the new architecture?
